summary: community.aws dropped support for botocore and boto3 older than 1.34.0; older SDKs may work but emit a warning.
questions: What boto3 version does community.aws require in Ansible 12?
Will community.aws work with an older boto3?

answer_card.title: community.aws requires boto3 1.34+
answer_card.answer_md: community.aws dropped support for `botocore<1.34.0` and `boto3<1.34.0`. Most modules still work with older SDKs, but compatibility isn't tested or guaranteed and Ansible emits a warning.
